options.reason: The table was evidently assembled for PAM50 subtyping: a wide matrix of log2 gene-expression floats (no missing values, no other metadata) plus exactly one categorical outcome with five observed subtype counts. Task is multiclass on PAM50, rows are tumours, and sample_id is the row key that must never be a feature. Select the model on TCGA only; evaluate once on the external CPTAC cohort (not in this schema, lacking Normal-like) which the brief fixes as the single holdout. Signature/centroid genes used to derive PAM50 (e.g. ESR1, ERBB2, MKI67, AURKA) would be leakage but none are confirmed here, so none are listed.
